course.title: Dynamics and Kinematics of Machineries
course.department: Department of Energy Science and Engineering

content.value: . A projectile is fired from the edge of a 180 m cliff with an initial velocity of 150 m/s, at an angle of 40° with the horizontal. Neglecting the air resistance, find – (i) the horizontal distance from the gun to the point where the projectile strikes the ground; (ii) the greatest elevation above the ground reached by the projectile.
